substance.statement: The report states how choose_target_bdf ranks the cards that fit: every element of its sort key in order, how free VRAM is compared, whether the inferring flag or the temperature is consulted first, how an unknown temperature is treated, and the final tie-break.

The report states the checks admit_load makes before it chooses a card, in order, with the reason code each refusal returns; which cards the two VRAM-temperature checks look at; and what the temperature_resume_below_c threshold does.

The report states how eviction_advice chooses the models it lists for a card that is short of VRAM: which models are eligible, the order in which they are taken, when it stops, whether the result is the smallest set that frees enough, and what it returns when the eligible models cannot cover the deficit.

REQUEST

FORM:

SOURCE FILES (commit 85cf67dafcd4):
=== FILE hearth/rotation/admission.py (sha256 c38174a3d86a, 164 lines) ===
CODE:
001| """Bytes-per-card admission for a model load (ADR-0040 §4 'HEARTH builds only the verified
002| absences'; ADR-0045 P4). Pure.
003| 
004| Gates ported from ``campaign/qwen38/scripts/server-control.ps1`` (commit floor before/during/after a
005| load; VRAM-temperature abort) with the campaign's values in ``campaign/qwen38/config/campaign.json``:
006| ``commit_min_free_gb 6.0``, ``vram_temperature_abort_c 95``, ``shared_growth_abort_gb 2.0``; the
007| scheduler's ``_VRAM_HEADROOM_GB 0.5`` per card. **Fail closed:** any gated quantity that is unknown
008| (``None``) refuses -- a load is an actuation, and "unmeasured" is not "fine".
009| 
010| Card choice (``choose_target_bdf``): the card with the most free VRAM, ties broken by the cooler
011| card -- the enforceable form of the rotation program's "the hot card gets the lighter model",
012| which ADR-0042 made unenforceable as an index rule. The choice is ADVICE for the sibling-entry
013| order; placement is still asserted after the load.
014| 
015| Co-residency numbers (ADR-0041 W-B 'during'): a resident-but-idle neighbour costs the incumbent 0%;
016| an actively inferring one on the same card ~8% while it infers. Reported, not gated.
017| """
018| from __future__ import annotations
019| 
020| from dataclasses import dataclass, field
021| from typing import Iterable, Optional
022| 
023| 
024| @dataclass(frozen=True)
025| class AdmissionGates:
026|     commit_min_free_gb: float = 6.0
027|     vram_headroom_gb: float = 0.5
028|     vram_temperature_abort_c: float = 95.0
029|     temperature_resume_below_c: float = 80.0
030|     shared_growth_abort_gb: float = 2.0
031|     card_vram_gb: float = 32.5
032| 
033| 
034| @dataclass(frozen=True)
035| class CardState:
036|     bdf: str
037|     vram_gb: float
038|     resident_gb: float                 # per-card GB already held (production 14.52 / 15.44)
039|     temp_c: Optional[float] = None
040|     inferring: bool = False            # an actively inferring tenant on this card (~8% cost)
041| 
042|     def free_gb(self, headroom_gb: float) -> float:
043|         return round(self.vram_gb - self.resident_gb - headroom_gb, 3)
044| 
045| 
046| @dataclass(frozen=True)
047| class Admission:
048|     ok: bool
049|     reason_code: str                   # ok | commit_floor | vram_fit | thermal | telemetry_unknown | cards_missing | model_unknown
050|     card_bdf: Optional[str]
051|     reasons: tuple = ()
052|     numbers: dict = field(default_factory=dict)
053| 
054| 
055| @dataclass(frozen=True)
056| class EvictionCandidate:
057|     model_id: str
058|     bdf: str
059|     gb: float
060|     reason: str
061| 
062| 
063| def _per_card_need(per_card_gb: Optional[float], vram_gb: Optional[float], placement: str) -> Optional[float]:
064|     if per_card_gb is not None:
065|         return float(per_card_gb)
066|     if vram_gb is not None:
067|         return float(vram_gb) / (2.0 if placement == "dual" else 1.0)
068|     return None
069| 
070| 
071| def choose_target_bdf(cards: Iterable[CardState], need_gb: float, gates: AdmissionGates) -> Optional[str]:
072|     """Freest card that fits; ties within 0.25 GB go to the cooler (or non-inferring) card."""
073|     fitting = [c for c in cards if c.free_gb(gates.vram_headroom_gb) >= need_gb]
074|     if not fitting:
075|         return None
076| 
077|     def key(card: CardState):
078|         temp = card.temp_c if card.temp_c is not None else 999.0
079|         return (-round(card.free_gb(gates.vram_headroom_gb) / 0.25), card.inferring, temp, card.bdf)
080| 
081|     return sorted(fitting, key=key)[0].bdf
082| 
083| 
084| def admit_load(*, per_card_gb: Optional[float], vram_gb: Optional[float], placement: str,
085|                cards: Iterable[CardState], commit_free_gb: Optional[float],
086|                gates: AdmissionGates = AdmissionGates(), model_id: str = "") -> Admission:
087|     """May this model be loaded now, and onto which card (single) or both (dual)?"""
088|     cards = tuple(cards)
089|     reasons: list = []
090|     numbers: dict = {"commit_free_gb": commit_free_gb, "placement": placement,
091|                      "cards": {c.bdf: {"free_gb": c.free_gb(gates.vram_headroom_gb),
092|                                        "temp_c": c.temp_c, "inferring": c.inferring} for c in cards}}
093|     need = _per_card_need(per_card_gb, vram_gb, placement)
094|     numbers["per_card_need_gb"] = need
095| 
096|     if not cards:
097|         return Admission(False, "cards_missing", None, ("no B70 telemetry -- nothing to admit onto",), numbers)
098|     if need is None:
099|         return Admission(False, "model_unknown", None,
100|                          (f"{model_id or 'model'} has no measured per-card or total VRAM (nullable stays null; "
101|                           "an unmeasured model is not admitted onto a production card)",), numbers)
102|     if commit_free_gb is None:
103|         return Admission(False, "telemetry_unknown", None, ("commit headroom unknown -- refusing (fail closed)",), numbers)
104|     if commit_free_gb < gates.commit_min_free_gb:
105|         return Admission(False, "commit_floor", None,
106|                          (f"commit free {commit_free_gb:.1f} GB < floor {gates.commit_min_free_gb:.1f} GB",), numbers)
107|     unknown_temp = [c.bdf for c in cards if c.temp_c is None]
108|     if unknown_temp:
109|         return Admission(False, "telemetry_unknown", None,
110|                          (f"VRAM temperature unknown on {', '.join(unknown_temp)} -- refusing (fail closed)",), numbers)
111|     hot = [c for c in cards if c.temp_c is not None and c.temp_c >= gates.vram_temperature_abort_c]
112|     if hot:
113|         return Admission(False, "thermal", None,
114|                          tuple(f"{c.bdf} at {c.temp_c:.0f} C >= abort {gates.vram_temperature_abort_c:.0f} C" for c in hot), numbers)
115| 
116|     if placement == "dual":
117|         short = [c for c in cards if c.free_gb(gates.vram_headroom_gb) < need]
118|         if len(cards) < 2:
119|             return Admission(False, "cards_missing", None, ("dual placement needs two B70s",), numbers)
120|         if short:
121|             return Admission(False, "vram_fit", None,
122|                              tuple(f"{c.bdf}: free {c.free_gb(gates.vram_headroom_gb):.2f} GB < need {need:.2f} GB" for c in short), numbers)
123|         warm = [c for c in cards if c.temp_c is not None and c.temp_c >= gates.temperature_resume_below_c]
124|         if warm:
125|             reasons.append("warm card(s): " + ", ".join(f"{c.bdf}@{c.temp_c:.0f}C" for c in warm))
126|         return Admission(True, "ok", None, tuple(reasons) or ("fits both cards",), numbers)
127| 
128|     target = choose_target_bdf(cards, need, gates)
129|     if target is None:
130|         return Admission(False, "vram_fit", None,
131|                          tuple(f"{c.bdf}: free {c.free_gb(gates.vram_headroom_gb):.2f} GB < need {need:.2f} GB" for c in cards), numbers)
132|     chosen = next(c for c in cards if c.bdf == target)
133|     if chosen.inferring:
134|         reasons.append(f"{target} hosts an actively inferring tenant (~8% while it infers, ADR-0041)")
135|     if chosen.temp_c is not None and chosen.temp_c >= gates.temperature_resume_below_c:
136|         reasons.append(f"{target} is warm ({chosen.temp_c:.0f} C)")
137|     return Admission(True, "ok", target, tuple(reasons) or (f"fits {target}",), numbers)
138| 
139| 
140| def eviction_advice(*, resident: Iterable[tuple], need_gb: float, placement: str,
141|                     cards: Iterable[CardState], gates: AdmissionGates = AdmissionGates(),
142|                     protected: frozenset = frozenset({"qwen3-30b-a3b"}),
143|                     in_flight: frozenset = frozenset()) -> list:
144|     """ADVICE only: which resident side models would have to go for ``need_gb`` to fit.
145| 
146|     ``resident`` = ``(model_id, bdf, gb)`` tuples. Never lists a protected model (production) or one
147|     with in-flight work (P7: swaps drain, they never cut). Smallest sufficient set per card.
148|     """
149|     cards = {c.bdf: c for c in cards}
150|     advice: list = []
151|     for bdf, card in cards.items():
152|         free = card.free_gb(gates.vram_headroom_gb)
153|         if free >= need_gb:
154|             continue
155|         deficit = need_gb - free
156|         candidates = sorted((r for r in resident if r[1] == bdf and r[0] not in protected and r[0] not in in_flight),
157|                             key=lambda r: r[2])
158|         freed = 0.0
159|         for model_id, _bdf, gb in candidates:
160|             if freed >= deficit:
161|                 break
162|             advice.append(EvictionCandidate(model_id, bdf, gb, f"frees {gb:.1f} GB toward a {deficit:.1f} GB deficit on {bdf}"))
163|             freed += gb
164|     return advice
=== END hearth/rotation/admission.py ===
